name: Curry Leaf
signature_dish: Catch-of-the-day fish curry cooked from scratch, eaten on a top-floor sea-view deck
why_it_matters: One of the most consistently praised seafood restaurants on Kovalam's Lighthouse Beach — fresh fish, curries cooked from scratch, and a top-floor deck with a breeze off the bay. Owner Sali's hospitality is part of the appeal, with regulars singing about personal touches like birthday cakes and fresh lobster catch.
insider_tip: They offer a free tuk-tuk to and from your hotel — ask when booking. The top floor has the best view and breeze. Pick your fish fresh; the curries are the strength.
signature_address: Curry Leaf, Lighthouse Beach, Kovalam, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695527

name: Santana Restaurant
signature_dish: Catch-of-the-day seafood and Kerala fish curry by the surf
why_it_matters: A long-standing Lighthouse Beach restaurant with outdoor seating right above the sand, Santana is known for the freshest daily catch and authentic Kerala dishes alongside continental fare. Open from early morning to late, it is one of the dependable all-day spots on the Kovalam strip.
insider_tip: Ask the staff for the catch of the day — they are happy to recommend. Open 6am to 11pm, so it works for breakfast through a late dinner. Outdoor tables for the sea view and breeze.
signature_address: Santana Restaurant, Lighthouse Beach, Kovalam, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695527

name: Fusion Restaurant
signature_dish: Fusion-style seafood and continental dishes on a shaded bay-view terrace
why_it_matters: A Lighthouse Beach restaurant at the quieter north end of the Kovalam strip, with a shady terrace looking straight onto the bay. The cooking leans genuinely fusion — more subtle and less classical than the rest of the strip — and reviewers single out the vegetable pakoras and the calm location.
insider_tip: The shaded terrace and quieter end of the beach make it good for a relaxed lunch away from the crowds. Food can be hit-or-miss — order the pakoras and the fusion plates rather than standard Indian dishes.
signature_address: Fusion Restaurant, Lighthouse Beach, Kovalam, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695527

name: Beatles Cafe Grill House
signature_dish: Grilled fish and meats with a sea view, plus all-day cafe and breakfast
why_it_matters: A Beatles-themed beachside cafe and grill on Lighthouse Beach near the Kovalam lighthouse — rustic wooden interiors, sea view a few steps from the sand, and a wide all-day menu of grills, seafood, steaks, breakfast and cafe classics. A relaxed chill-out spot with music on the Kovalam strip.
insider_tip: The ordinary fish and meat grills are better value than the famous seafood-grill platter, which reviewers find overpriced. Prices are fair for a beachfront spot. Good for breakfast or an evening with music.
signature_address: Beatles Cafe Grill House, Lighthouse Beach, Kovalam, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695527

name: Devi Garden Restaurant
signature_dish: Home-cooked Kerala meals at family-run prices, away from the beach strip
why_it_matters: A family-run restaurant on the Kovalam Beach Road near Kovalam Junction, away from the tourist-priced beach strip. Devi Garden is where locals point visitors who want home-cooked Kerala food at honest prices — wholesome everyday meals straight from a Kovalam kitchen.
insider_tip: Go here rather than the Lighthouse Beach restaurants if you want a cheap, authentic Kerala lunch — it is a fraction of beach-strip prices. Order the Kerala meals or fish curry. Cash and UPI.
signature_address: Devi Garden Restaurant, Kovalam Beach Road, Kovalam Junction, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695527
